examples:
$serverApp = Get-CMAADApplication -TenantName "Contoso" -AppType ServerApplication -AppName "CmgServerApp"

$clientApp = Get-CMAADApplication -TenantName "Contoso" -AppType ClientApplication -AppName "CmgClientApp"

New-CMCloudManagementAzureService -Name "Contoso" -Description "Azure Service" -ServerApp $serverApp -ClientApp $clientApp -AzureEnvironmentOption AzurePublicCloud

parameters.name: AddGroupName
parameters.description: Specify a Microsoft Entra group name to discover. Use this parameter with the EnableGroupDiscovery parameter.

parameters.name: AzureEnvironmentOption
parameters.description: Specify whether this service is in the global Azure cloud (AzurePublicCloud), or the Azure Government cloud (AzureUSGovernmentCloud).

parameters.name: ClientApp
parameters.description: Specify an object for the client app registration. To get this app, use the Get-CMAADApplication cmdlet.

parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: EnableGroupDeltaDiscovery
parameters.description: Set this parameter to true to enable delta discovery for Microsoft Entra group discovery. Use this parameter with the EnableGroupDiscovery parameter. Use the GroupDeltaDiscoveryMins parameter to configure the delta discovery interval.

parameters.name: EnableGroupDiscovery
parameters.description: Set this parameter to true to enable Microsoft Entra group discovery. When you enable this discovery method, also configure the following parameters: - AddGroupName: Add Microsoft Entra groups to discover - EnableGroupDeltaDiscovery: Configure delta discovery - GroupDeltaDiscoveryMins: Delta discovery interval - GroupDiscoverySchedule: Full polling schedule For more information on this discovery method, see Microsoft Entra user group discovery.

parameters.name: EnableUserDeltaDiscovery
parameters.description: Set this parameter to true to enable delta discovery for Microsoft Entra user discovery. Use this parameter with the EnableUserDiscovery parameter.

parameters.name: EnableUserDiscovery
parameters.description: Set this parameter to true to enable Microsoft Entra user discovery. When you enable this discovery method, also configure the following parameters: - EnableUserDeltaDiscovery: Configure delta discovery - UserDeltaDiscoveryMins: Delta discovery interval - UserDiscoverySchedule: Full polling schedule For more information on this discovery method, see Microsoft Entra user discovery.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: GroupDeltaDiscoveryMins
parameters.description: When you enable delta discovery for Microsoft Entra group discovery with the EnableGroupDeltaDiscovery parameter, use this parameter to configure the delta discovery interval. The integer value you specify is the polling interval in minutes.

parameters.name: GroupDiscoverySchedule
parameters.description: Specify a schedule object for the Microsoft Entra group discovery full polling schedule. To get this object, use the New-CMSchedule cmdlet.

examples:
$Path = "c:\TestPath\RootCA.cer"
$Type = [Microsoft.ConfigurationManagement.AdminConsole.AzureServices.CertificateStore]::RootCA
$Cert =@{$Path = $Type}

$Password = '0HNy*c@63kAe' | ConvertTo-SecureString -AsPlainText -Force

New-CMCloudManagementGateway -ServiceCertPath "c:\TestPath\ServiceCert.pfx" -EnvironmentSetting AzurePublicCloud -SubscriptionId "aaaa0a0a-bb1b-cc2c-dd3d-eeeeee4e4e4e" -ServiceCertPassword $Password -ServiceName "GraniteFalls.CloudApp.Net" -Description "EastUS CMG for Contoso" -Region EastUS -VMInstanceCount 2 -CARootCert $Cert -CheckClientCertRevocation $False -EnforceProtocol $True -IsUsingExistingGroup $true -GroupName "Resource group 1"

New-CMCloudManagementGateway -ServiceCertPath "c:\TestPath\ServiceCert.pfx" -EnvironmentSetting AzurePublicCloud -SubscriptionId "aaaa0a0a-bb1b-cc2c-dd3d-eeeeee4e4e4e" -ServiceCertPassword $Password -ServiceName "GraniteFalls.CloudApp.Net" -Description "EastUS CMG for Contoso" -Region EastUS -VMInstanceCount 2 -CARootCert $Cert -CheckClientCertRevocation $False -EnforceProtocol $True -GroupName "Resource group 1" -EnableCloudDPFunction $true -EnableTrafficOut $true -TrafficOutStopService $true -TrafficOutGB 10000 -TrafficWarningPct 50 -TrafficCriticalPct 90 -EnableStorageQuota $true -StorageQuotaGB 2000 -StorageWarningPct 50 -StorageCriticalPct 90 -Force

parameters.name: CARootCert
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Add root certificates to the cloud service.

parameters.name: CheckClientCertRevocation
parameters.description: Set this parameter to true to verify client certificate revocation. A certificate revocation list (CRL) must be publicly published for this verification to work. For more information, see Publish the certificate revocation list.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: An optional description of the CMG, to better identify it in the Configuration Manager console.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: EnableCloudDPFunction
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Enable or disable the option to Allow CMG to function as a cloud distribution point and serve content from Azure storage.

parameters.name: EnableStorageQuota
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Enable or disable the option to Specify storage alert threshold.

parameters.name: EnableTrafficOut
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Enable or disable the option to Turn on 14-day threshold and alerts for monitoring outbound data transfer.

parameters.name: EnforceProtocol
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Enable or disable the option to Enforce TLS 1.2.

parameters.name: EnvironmentSetting
parameters.description: Specify Azure environment to deploy the CMG: in the global Azure cloud (AzurePublicCloud) or the Azure Government cloud (AzureUSGovernmentCloud).

parameters.name: Force
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Run the command without asking for confirmation. If the service certificate contains multiple DNS names, use this parameter to avoid warnings from the cmdlet.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Specify the name of the Azure resource group.

parameters.name: IsUsingExistingGroup
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Specify if the Azure resource group already exists.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: Specify the Azure service region, for example: WestUS2.

parameters.name: ServerAppClientId
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Specify the client ID of the Microsoft Entra server app. Use this parameter for non-user interaction mode. In the CMG properties, this value is the Microsoft Entra app name.

parameters.name: ServiceCertPassword
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Specify the password for the service certificate.

parameters.name: ServiceCertPath
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Specify the path to the service certificate. For more information, see CMG server authentication certificate.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Specify the Azure service name. If you don't specify this parameter, Configuration Manager uses the service certificate's first DNS name. If the certificate has more than one DNS name, use this parameter to specify which one to use.

parameters.name: StorageCriticalPct
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Specify an integer value for the Generate Critical alert (% of storage alert threshold). For example, 90.

parameters.name: StorageQuotaGB
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Specify an integer value for the Storage alert threshold (GB). For example, 2.

parameters.name: StorageWarningPct
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Specify an integer value for the Generate Warning alert (% of storage alert threshold). For example, 50.

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the Azure subscription where you want to deploy this new cloud service. The format of this value is a standard GUID.

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.description: Mandatory parameter where tenantId needs to be added while creating cmg.

parameters.name: TrafficCriticalPct
parameters.description: If you enable alerts for monitoring outbound data transfer, specify the percentage of threshold for raising a Critical alert. This value is 90 by default.

parameters.name: TrafficOutGB
parameters.description: If you enable storage alerts, use this parameter to specify the storage alert threshold in GB. The default value is 2.

parameters.name: TrafficOutStopService
parameters.description: Applies to version 2010 and later. Enable or disable the option to Stop this service when the critical threshold is exceeded.

parameters.name: TrafficWarningPct
parameters.description: If you enable alerts for monitoring outbound data transfer, specify the percentage of threshold for raising a Warning alert. This value is 50 by default.

parameters.name: VMInstanceCount
parameters.description: Specify the instance count of virtual machines for the CMG in Azure.
